# Physio exercises

## Next steps

Resting heart rate is down to 60 after three months. Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away. Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent.

## Status

Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast. Intervals on Tuesday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest. Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine.

## Context

Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
